## What did you run?

Notebook or script name, commit, operating system, Python version, and package versions.

## Dataset access and version

State only the public source/version. Do not attach participant-level data, local paths, or provider-restricted material.

## Expected versus observed behaviour

Include the complete non-sensitive error message and minimal steps to reproduce.
